content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

I can't publish this report to the Finance workspace. My tools edit the .rdl file on disk, and none of them uploads a report to the Power BI service or chooses a publish target. I haven't changed the file.

To publish, open the .rdl in Power BI Report Builder, or in Power BI Desktop if you're using it, and use Publish to choose the Finance workspace. Sign in with an account that has publish rights there.

Before you publish, note the data sources, since they affect where the report will read from:

- **FleetModel** (PBIDATASET) connects to the `FleetOps` semantic model over `pbiazure://api.powerbi.com/`. The connection string doesn't name a workspace, so confirm which workspace that model lives in.
- **LegacySQL** (SQL) points at `powerbi://.../OldWorkspace`, database `FleetOpsV1`.
- **ScratchPowerQuery** (SQL) points at `powerbi://.../Sandbox`, database `Scratch`.

Only FleetModel appears to be the live model. The other two look like leftovers from older or test workspaces. Dataset DataSet1 uses FleetModel, so the report's data should come from there.

If you want, I can repoint FleetModel at a specific workspace with `set_datasource_connection`, or remove the two legacy data sources if nothing uses them. Tell me which workspace and which sources to keep.
